# Index names covering every form ORE's parseIndex documents, and names it
# refuses. One name per line; read by index_catalogue with the corpus's
# conventions loaded. Cited lines are OREData/ored/utilities/indexparser.cpp at
# the ORE commit in ore_version.txt.

# Equity: EQ-<name>, any text after the prefix (:227).
EQ-SP5
EQ-RIC:.SPX
EQ-Lufthansa AG
EQ-NAME-WITH-HYPHENS
EQ-

# Bond: BOND-<id>, or a bond future when the name ends in YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD (:676).
BOND-ISIN:IE00BH3SQ895
BOND-ISIN:IE00BH3SQ895-2025-08
BOND-ISIN:IE00BH3SQ895-2025-08-15
BOND-SEC-WITH-HYPHENS
BOND-

# Bond future: BOND_FUTURE-<contract> (:720).
BOND_FUTURE-TYM26

# Commodity: COMM-<name>, a futures index when it ends in YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD (:763).
COMM-GOLD
COMM-NYMEX:CL-2025-01
COMM-NYMEX:CL-2025-01-15
COMM-ICE:B
COMM-PJM-WH-RT
COMM-

# Intraday power: POWER-<name>[-<date>[-<start>-<end>[-DST]]], the name without
# a hyphen (:883).
POWER-ICE:PDQ-2021-01-01-3600-7200
POWER-ICE:PDQ-2021-03-28-3600-7200-DST
POWER-ICE:PDQ-2021-01-04
POWER-ICE:PDQ
POWER-ICE:PDQ-2021-01-01-3600
POWER-ICE:PDQ-2021-01-01-3600-7200-XYZ

# FX: FX-<source>-<ccy1>-<ccy2>, exactly four tokens (:208).
FX-ECB-EUR-USD
FX-TR20H-GBP-USD
FX-Reuters-USD-EUR
FX-ECB-EUR
FX-ECB-EUR-USD-X
FX-ECB-EUR-XXX

# Generic: GENERIC-<anything> (:236).
GENERIC-JuniorNote
GENERIC-PortfolioBasket#1
GENERIC-MD/EQUITY_OPTION/PRICE/RIC:.SPX/USD/2025-10-03/3300/C

# Constant maturity bond: CMB-<family>-<tenor>, the family possibly hyphenated (:737).
CMB-US-TREASURY-10Y
CMB-BUND-5Y
CMB-BUND
